# `/org-config` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /org-config/v1

`getOrgConfigV1` — Get org config settings

Get the current organization's configuration settings, only external accessible properties.

- Scopes: idn:org-configs:manage, idn:org-configs:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Returns 200: orgconfig

### PATCH /org-config/v1

`patchOrgConfigV1` — Patch org config

Patch the current organization's configuration, using http://jsonpatch.com/ syntax. This is commonly used to changing an organization's time zone.

- Scopes: idn:org-configs:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: orgconfig

### GET /org-config/v1/valid-time-zones

`getValidTimeZonesV1` — Get valid time zones

List the valid time zones that can be set in organization configurations.

- Scopes: idn:org-configs-user:read, idn:org-configs:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN

- Returns 200: array of string
